name: Nishimatsu Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Nishimatsu Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company offers asset value-added services and regional environmental solutions. It also engages in the development, sale, leasing, management, and other businesses of real estate.
